abilities.name: Kanned Rage
abilities.text: Whenever a Killa Kan is Exhausted or fails a Resolve Test, roll 1d6. If you roll an Icon, the Killa Kan becomes Frenzied, ignoring any penalties and continuing to fight.

abilities.name: Explosive
abilities.text: When a Killa Kan dies, roll a d6. If you roll a Complication, the Killa Kan explodes. Killa Kan Explosion: 12 +5 ED / Blast (10)

mobAbilities.name: Scrag 'Em
mobAbilities.text: When a Mob of Killa Kans makes a melee attack Test, it gains a number of bonus dice equal to the Tier of the game.

mobAbilities.name: Mob Confidence
mobAbilities.text: A Mob of Killa Kans gains +1 bonus dice to Resolve Tests for every individual in the Mob.
